# Code Quality & Architecture Checklist: Feature 047

**Purpose**: Requirements-quality review checklist ("Unit Tests for Requirements") for CSS selector deduplication, modular style decomposition, and test coverage threshold governance  
**Created**: 2026-10-16  
**Feature**: [specs/047-static-quality-governance/spec.md](file:///c:/Users/Rogerio%20Teixeira/OneDrive/Documentos/Antigravity/Metrik/specs/047-static-quality-governance/spec.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.  
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.  
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

---

## 1. Reconciliação & Deduplicação de Seletores CSS (CSS Duplication Requirements Quality)

- [ ] CHK001 Are all 12 duplicate selectors explicitly inventoried and mapped to their canonical domain modules? [Completeness, Spec §US1.AC1]
- [ ] CHK002 Is the target for `DUPLICATE_BASELINE` in `tests/unit/cssDuplicationGuard.test.ts` specified to be exactly zero (`new Set([])`) without residual tolerance? [Clarity, Spec §Clarifications.Q3]
- [ ] CHK003 Does the spec define that selector deduplication must preserve identical computed styles across Light, Dark, and High Contrast themes? [Consistency, Spec §US1.AC3]
- [ ] CHK004 Are hover, focus, and active pseudo-class behaviors specified to be preserved during rule consolidation? [Coverage, Spec §Edge Cases]

---

## 2. Decomposição Modular & Descontinuação de Módulos Heterogêneos (Style Modularization Quality)

- [ ] CHK005 Is the redistribution of 100% of the style rules from `src/styles/13-recovered.css` to domain-specific files explicitly required? [Completeness, Spec §FR-004]
- [ ] CHK006 Is the removal of `13-recovered.css` from the `@import` manifest in `src/App.css` clearly specified? [Clarity, Spec §FR-004]
- [ ] CHK007 Does the spec mandate updating the structural test `tests/unit/appCssStructure.test.ts` to reflect the updated module list? [Traceability, Spec §Clarifications.Q1]
- [ ] CHK008 Are CSS specificity order constraints documented to prevent accidental cascade inversions? [Consistency, Spec §Edge Cases]

---

## 3. Governança de Cobertura & Limiares Automatizados (Test Coverage Governance Quality)

- [ ] CHK009 Are the specific minimum thresholds for `vite.config.ts` quantified as `functions: 60`, `statements: 85`, `lines: 85`, and `branches: 78`? [Measurability, Spec §Clarifications.Q2]
- [ ] CHK010 Is the generation of both HTML and LCOV reports in `coverage/` specified as a mandatory verification output? [Completeness, Spec §US3.AC1]
- [ ] CHK011 Does the spec require that the 701 existing unit tests remain green without loosening or skipping any assertions? [Constitution III, Spec §FR-007]
- [ ] CHK012 Is execution time for coverage instrumentation bounded to prevent local or CI pipeline timeouts? [Measurability, Spec §Edge Cases]

---

## 4. Não-Regressão & Performance de Distribuição (Build & Pipeline Quality)

- [ ] CHK013 Is production build execution time quantified with an objective threshold (< 5 seconds)? [Measurability, Spec §SC-004]
- [ ] CHK014 Is zero-warning compliance on `npm run lint` maintained with `@typescript-eslint/no-explicit-any` as error? [Traceability, Spec §SC-005]
- [ ] CHK015 Are assumptions regarding theme CSS variables in `01-design-system-core.css` explicitly documented? [Assumption, Spec §Assumptions]

---

## Notes

- Mark items `[x]` only after review confirms the requirement-quality criterion is satisfied.
- Leave items unchecked when they still require clarification, correction, or reviewer evaluation.
- `/speckit-implement` reads checklist checkbox state as a gate and must not modify markers.
- `checklists/requirements.md` has a separate built-in lifecycle maintained by `/speckit-specify` and `/speckit-clarify`.
